sector_verification_note: TIER C THROUGHOUT, and this sector makes a point worth generalising: NEW STATUTE DOES NOT MEAN NEW CREDENTIALING. The National Sports Governance Act 2025 is the most significant Indian sports legislation in decades and it regulates federations, tribunals and elections - it licenses no coach, no official and no athlete. Federation coaching and officiating licences are real gates but they are contractual, imposed by employers and competitions rather than by law. The sector's decisive fact is economic rather than regulatory: for most Indian athletes the income from sport is a 7th CPC government salary obtained THROUGH sport via the sports quota, not prize money or a contract.

professions.one_liner: Competes in a sport for a living - through a league, a federation, or a sports quota job.

deviating_roles.why: Both are competitive sports in which physical output is nearly irrelevant and concentration under long pressure is everything. Chess in particular has a career shape unlike any other sport here - it starts earlier and lasts far longer.
The league sports. These are the only three in India with genuine professional contracts and public visibility, which changes both the money and the pressure.

Para sport carries the same training demands with a fraction of the funding, the coaching infrastructure and the commercial attention - and a classification system that can reclassify an athlete out of their event.

Motorsport is spatial judgment and reaction at speed with a real and continuous risk of injury, sustained for hours. A rally co-driver does not drive at all - they read pace notes aloud at the exact moment the driver needs them, which is a navigation and nerve discipline of its own.

path_to_entry.requirement: None. Serious training starts in childhood; by class 11 an athlete is usually already competing at state level.
Academy, SAI centre, Khelo India centre or a private club. Selection is by performance at district and state meets.
Place in National Championships, National Games or Category A/B/C championships - this is what unlocks both selection and the sports quota.
A league contract in cricket, football or kabaddi; or - far more commonly - a sports quota post in the railways, police, a bank or the armed forces.

public_routes: Sports quota recruitment (Railways, police, banks, PSUs)
entrance_exams.note: There is no entrance examination. The qualifying currency is a sporting placing, and the sports quota converts it into a permanent government job.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Prize money, appearance fees, coaching and endorsements - and for most athletes outside the three league sports, none of these is the main income. The sports quota government post is.

ai_exposure.reason: Among the least exposed professions in the dataset. Sport is a human body competing against another human body and an audience that wants to watch people do it. Nothing generative touches the work. Chess Player is the one genuine exception in a sense no other profession faces: engines have been superhuman for decades, and the game survived because the market was never for the best moves but for people playing.

nuances.statement: The single most misunderstood record in this sector. Outside cricket, football and kabaddi, an Indian athlete's income is usually not from sport at all - it is a 7th CPC government salary obtained THROUGH sport via the sports quota, at Level 1 to Level 5. That is a modest but permanent, pensionable job, and it is a far better outcome than the word 'athlete' suggests to most families.

There is a real and brutal window that this schema field cannot hold, because it is not about age. Sports quota eligibility counts achievements from the current and previous two financial years only. An athlete who peaks at 19 and declines by 23 can be shut out of the route entirely, having given the years.

Low, and it should be read as 'very few paid places' rather than 'do not do this'. Sport at school and state level is participation; the number of people paid to compete in India is small in every discipline except cricket.

economics.distribution is 'power_law', which is a statement that the range and the midpoint should not be read as a typical income. Outside cricket, football and kabaddi almost nobody earns from competing. The realistic outcome is a sports quota government salary, which is a different distribution entirely. The compensation filter does not fire on a power_law record, because deleting a profession on the strength of a number the record itself calls meaningless would be worse than showing it.

MOTORSPORT IS PAY-TO-RACE AND THE COST FIGURE ON THIS RECORD DOES NOT COVER IT. Every other athlete here has a cost of entry near 3 lakh and earns from competing. A motorsport racer BUYS THE SEAT - karting through to formula and touring car seasons are funded by the driver or by sponsorship the driver must raise themselves, and a season runs to many lakh. The income structure is inverted relative to the rest of the profession, and a family should understand that before a teenager asks for the first karting season. No sourced Indian figure for a season's cost was found, which is why it is stated as a shape rather than a number.

admin_review.reason: Two gaps. First, this is a power-law income like Actor and Digital Content Creator, and a range misrepresents it. Second and more fixable: the sports quota route is the realistic outcome for most athletes and the record has no sourced figure for what a Level 1 to Level 5 railway post actually pays in hand. That number exists - it is on the 7th CPC matrix - and until it is fetched the most likely outcome of this career is unquantified. A third gap has been added: motorsport is PAY-TO-RACE and this record's cost_of_entry_lakh of 3.0 does not describe it at all. A sourced figure for an Indian karting or formula season is needed, and if it is as far outside the range as expected, Motorsport Racer may need to leave this record for one of its own.

professions.one_liner: Trains athletes and teams to perform - technique, tactics, conditioning and selection.

deviating_roles.why: These are applied physiology roles - load management, testing and injury return protocols. The work is programme design and measurement rather than technique on the field, and it sits closest to sports science.
Scouting is judgment about who a fourteen-year-old will become, made from watching hundreds of them. It is prediction, and the coach never trains most of the people they assess.
Coaching children is about keeping them in the sport, managing parents and building confidence. Winning is not the objective, which inverts the rest of the profession.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. Most coaches come from having played the sport.
NSNIS Patiala diploma or certificate in sports coaching, a federation coaching licence, or a BPEd/MPEd. None is legally required.
Sport-specific federation licences - AIFF and BCCI run graded levels. These are what clubs and academies actually ask for.
Academy, school, club, state association or SAI centre; or private coaching on your own account.

public_routes: Sports quota recruitment (Railways, police, banks, PSUs)
private_entrances: Federation coaching licences (AIFF, BCCI and others)
entrance_exams.note: None is legally required to coach. Federation licences are contractual requirements set by employers and competitions, not statutory ones.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Private coaching, running an academy, or personal coaching of individual athletes. An academy with fifty paying children earns more reliably than most salaried coaching posts.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure. Coaching is watching a specific body move, knowing what is wrong, and getting a person to change a habit under pressure - none of which is a text problem. Team Analyst is the exposed role: video tagging and statistical breakdown is already largely automated, and what survives is the interpretation. Grassroots & Youth Coach is the safest work here and also the largest employer.

nuances.statement: A genuinely arguable placement. DECISIONS.md 2 sends teaching-anything to Sector 12, and a coach clearly teaches. It sits here because the object of concern is COMPETITIVE PERFORMANCE rather than learning: a coach is accountable for whether the athlete wins, selects the squad, and manages injury and load. A Physical Education Teacher, who is accountable for a curriculum and a class, is routed to Sector 12 instead.

Null, and worth stating plainly because the National Sports Governance Act 2025 has just created new statutory machinery. That Act regulates federations, tribunals and elections - it licenses no coach. Federation coaching licences are real gates but they are contractual, set by employers and competitions.

professions.one_liner: Gets ordinary people fitter and keeps them safe doing it - gyms, studios, homes, online.

deviating_roles.why: Online coaching is programme writing, check-ins and accountability by message. The trainer never touches the client, which removes the safety role that defines the rest of the profession.
Training older adults and people with medical conditions is caution-led work with real clinical risk, done in close coordination with physiotherapists and doctors.
Leading a room of thirty people to music is performance. The instructor motivates a crowd rather than correcting an individual.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream, or none. Most certifying bodies require class 12 or equivalent.
A personal training certification - SPEFL-SC / NSQF aligned, or an international body. Gyms ask for one; no law does.
Gym floor instructor, then personal training clients. Almost all Indian gym trainers start salaried and move to commission.
Own client roster, a studio, or online coaching - where the income actually changes.

private_entrances: Personal training certifications (SPEFL-SC, ACE, ACSM and others)
entrance_exams.note: No public entrance exists. Certification is a private market and the qualification employers ask for is set by the gym, not by statute.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Personal training clients taken directly, a small studio, or online coaching. Trainers with a full private roster earn multiples of the gym floor salary, which is why almost everyone in this profession is trying to get there.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure with one clear crack. Online Fitness Coach is directly exposed - generating a training programme from goals, height and weight is exactly what a model does well, and app based coaching already competes on price. What survives is presence: spotting a failing squat, adjusting a grip, and being the reason someone turned up at six in the morning. Personal Trainer and Senior & Special Population Trainer are protected by touch and liability.

nuances.statement: High and genuinely growing - urban gym membership, corporate wellness and post-pandemic health awareness have all expanded the market. This is the most reliably employable profession in Sector 11 and the one with the lowest barrier to entry, which also means the most competition.

Null, and this is a real consumer-safety gap rather than a neutral fact. Anyone in India may call themselves a personal trainer and take money to load a stranger's spine. Certification is entirely a private market with no floor.

professions.one_liner: Runs the competition itself - refereeing, umpiring, judging, timing and scoring.

deviating_roles.why: Judging gymnastics, diving or boxing is applying a written code to a movement seen once, in seconds, with no replay in most Indian competition. It is assessment rather than enforcement.
On-field officiating is authority under open hostility from players, coaches and a crowd, while physically keeping up with the game. Being liked is not part of it.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
State or national federation officiating examination for the sport - BCCI's umpiring levels, AIFF referee courses and their equivalents.
Get onto a district, then state, then national panel. Progression is by assessment on matches actually officiated.
Match fees per fixture. Only the top national panels in cricket offer anything resembling a full income.

public_routes: Federation officiating examinations (BCCI, AIFF and others)
entrance_exams.note: These are federation examinations, not statutory ones - they control who may officiate that federation's competitions and nothing beyond it.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Match fees, which is how essentially all officiating is paid. Officials at the top of a national panel in cricket earn a real income; everyone below that is doing it alongside another job.

ai_exposure.reason: Genuinely contested, and this is the one profession in Sector 11 where technology has already taken work. Timekeeper & Scorer is substantially automated, and ball tracking, goal-line technology and video review have moved decisions away from the on-field official in every sport that can afford them. What remains is the part machines cannot do: managing twenty-two angry people, applying judgment where the code is silent, and being the person accountable for the call.

nuances.statement: Match-fee income, and for almost everyone in this profession it is a second income rather than a livelihood. The wide mid-career range is the gap between a district panel official officiating on weekends and a national panel cricket umpire.

Low in paid terms and steady in real terms - every competition needs officials and India is chronically short of qualified ones, particularly in women's sport and outside cricket. Scarcity here has not translated into pay.

admin_review.reason: No sourced figure for Indian match fees at any level, in any sport, and match fees are the entire income of this profession. At 4.9 LPA mid-career with a named self-employment route and no ceiling, the record cannot distinguish a weekend district official from a national panel umpire - which is the only distinction that matters here.

professions.one_liner: Takes people safely into mountains, rivers and the sea, and teaches them to move there.

deviating_roles.why: Outdoor education runs school and corporate programmes where the objective is confidence, teamwork or leadership. The activity is a vehicle; the client is usually frightened and unfit.
Both operate under international certifying bodies with strict procedural discipline and equipment checks, where a missed step is fatal rather than embarrassing.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
Basic and Advanced Mountaineering courses at NIM Uttarkashi, HMI Darjeeling or another government institute; or international certification for diving and paragliding.
Logged days - summits, dives, river descents or flights. This is what actually qualifies you in the eyes of an employer.
Adventure tour operators, outdoor education companies, or your own operation. Work is seasonal and tied to a specific geography.

public_routes: Mountaineering course admission (NIM, HMI and state institutes)
private_entrances: Scuba and paragliding certifications (PADI, SSI and equivalents)
entrance_exams.note: Government mountaineering institutes run the main Indian courses and are heavily oversubscribed; diving and flying are certified by international private bodies, which are the only real route in those disciplines.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Running your own trips, or a small operation with equipment. Owning gear - boats, ropes, dive kit - is what separates a guide on a day rate from an operator taking the margin.

ai_exposure.reason: Essentially unexposed, and one of the clearest cases in the model of physical skill in an unstructured environment being a moat rather than a liability. Route-finding, reading weather, judging whether a client can continue and rescuing them when they cannot are all decisions made with a body in a place. No role here has meaningful exposure.

nuances.statement: Moderate and concentrated - this work exists in Uttarakhand, Himachal, Ladakh, the Northeast, Goa and the Andamans and almost nowhere else. It is also strongly seasonal, so a full year's income usually means following the season across two regions or holding a winter job.

Placed here rather than in Sector 16 with travel because the object of concern is physical performance and safety in a demanding environment, not hospitality. Adventure tourism is the EMPLOYER, and DECISIONS.md 2.2 says an employer is a tag.

professions.one_liner: Competes or works professionally in organised competitive video gaming.

deviating_roles.why: Broadcast roles are live commentary and vision-mixing over a match nobody controls. They are the most transferable jobs in esports and the only ones with an obvious career outside it.
Coaching and analysis in esports is drafting, strategy and reviewing recorded matches frame by frame. It is closer to a chess second than to a sports coach on a field.

path_to_entry.requirement: None.
Reach the top competitive ranks of a title with an Indian scene. This is public and verifiable, which makes entry unusually meritocratic.
Join an organised roster and compete in qualifiers and tournaments.
Team salary and prize money, streaming income, or the non-playing roles - coaching, casting, tournament operations.

entrance_exams.note: None. Ranking is the only qualification and it is public.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Streaming and content alongside competing, which is how most Indian esports players actually earn. Prize money alone supports very few.

ai_exposure.reason: The most exposed profession in Sector 11 and the reason is unusual: the competitive titles themselves are AI-adjacent, and the surrounding jobs are digital. Team Analyst (Esports) is directly exposed - match review and draft analysis is pattern recognition over recorded data. Professional Player is protected in the same way Chess Player is: the audience is watching humans compete, and superhuman bots have existed in several titles for years without affecting that at all.

nuances.statement: Low, and this needs saying bluntly because it is one of the most aspired-to careers among Indian teenagers. India has a very large gaming AUDIENCE and a very small number of paid competitive places - perhaps a few hundred salaried players nationally across all titles. Reading audience size as opportunity is the DECISIONS.md 8.45 error in its most tempting form.

A power-law distribution again, and with a shorter career than any other profession in this dataset - competitive playing careers commonly end in the mid-twenties. The non-playing roles are the realistic long-term work and they pay less than the equivalent job outside esports.

Two years is the time to reach a competitive roster, not a qualification - there is none. What the number hides is that the training is thousands of hours of play with no transferable credential at the end if it does not work out.

economics.distribution is 'power_law', which is a statement that the range and the midpoint should not be read as a typical income. A few hundred paid roster places nationally against a very large amateur population, and a playing career that commonly ends in the mid-twenties. The compensation filter does not fire on a power_law record, because deleting a profession on the strength of a number the record itself calls meaningless would be worse than showing it.

admin_review.reason: Aspiration-to-reality gap is the widest in the dataset. No sourced figure exists for Indian esports salaries, prize distribution or the number of paid roster spots, and every one of those is needed before this record can be shown to a fifteen-year-old. Decide also whether the very short playing career should be surfaced as a structural warning rather than left in a nuance.

professions.one_liner: Measures what athletes do and turns it into training decisions - physiology, biomechanics, data.

deviating_roles.why: Performance psychology is conversation and behavioural work with an athlete under pressure. It shares an employer with the rest of this profession and almost no method.
Analysis is video, tracking data and statistics rather than laboratory physiology. It is the fastest-growing part of the profession and the most portable outside sport.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream; Biology and Physical Education help for the physiology route.
BSc/MSc in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, or a BPEd/MPEd. Data-side entrants often come from statistics or computing.
SAI centre, national federation, a professional club, or a private high-performance facility.
Physiology, biomechanics, analysis or psychology - they diverge quickly and only analysis transfers easily outside sport.

entrance_exams.note: Neither is required. Sports science degrees are a normal university admission rather than a specialist gate.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Consultancy to clubs, academies and individual athletes, usually after building a reputation inside an institution. A small private testing or analysis practice is the common form.

ai_exposure.reason: The most exposed non-esports role here. Performance Analyst and Sports Data Analyst work is video tagging, event coding and statistical modelling, and automated tracking already does most of the collection - what survives is deciding what the numbers mean for one athlete's next eight weeks. Exercise Physiologist and Biomechanist are protected by having to put sensors on a real body and interpret an individual's response.

nuances.statement: Low in India specifically, and the reason is structural: high performance support staff exist where there is money in the sport, which in India means cricket, a handful of federations and the SAI system. The skills transfer well abroad and to general healthcare, which is why pathway is 'any'.

Tagged to EXT-RND as well as SPEFL because a good deal of this work is genuine applied research. The boundary with Sector 3 is method: a sports scientist measuring an athlete to change their training is intervening, not investigating.

professions.one_liner: Prepares and maintains where sport is played - pitches, courts, pools, tracks and gyms.

deviating_roles.why: Preparing a cricket pitch is agronomy with a competitive outcome attached - soil, moisture, rolling and grass judged against how the match should play. A senior curator is consulted by captains and is one of the few people in this profession with real standing.
Kit management is inventory, logistics and preparation rather than groundwork, and it travels with the team.

path_to_entry.requirement: None.
On the job under a working groundsman. Turf management courses exist and are rare; almost nobody enters through one.
Ground staff at a club, stadium, school, university or municipal facility.
Curation, turf science or facility management - the routes by which this becomes a skilled trade rather than manual work.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Contract maintenance of grounds and facilities for schools, clubs and housing societies - a small crew and equipment is the whole business, and it is how experienced ground staff raise their income.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed. Preparing a surface is outdoor physical work responding to weather, soil and use, and there is no digital output to substitute for. The one role with any exposure is Equipment & Kit Manager, through inventory software rather than through anything interesting.

nuances.statement: The base layer of the sports sector, and it fails the compensation filter. Ground staff at most Indian clubs and municipal facilities are on casual or contract terms. The exception worth knowing is that a recognised cricket pitch curator at a first class venue is a genuinely skilled and respected position.

Moderate and quietly stable - every school, club, stadium, university and gated community with a sports facility needs this work done, and the number of such facilities is growing. It is one of the few sports livelihoods available in a small town.

admin_review.reason: No sourced wage figure for Indian ground staff or curators, and no figure for what a contract maintenance operation earns - the route named as the way out of a 4.2 LPA employed ceiling. Also unresolved: whether the senior cricket curator role is sufficiently different in pay and standing to need its own treatment.

routed_elsewhere.why: Accountable for a curriculum and a class rather than for competitive performance. This is the deliberate counterpart to keeping Sports Coach here - the same subject, split by what the person is answerable for.
Already built in Sector 4 as a job role under Physiotherapist. Treating injury is clinical work under a statutory council whatever the patient does for a living.
Already built in Sector 4 under Dietitian & Clinical Nutritionist.
Already built in Sector 9 as a job role under Journalist & Reporter.
Staging a tournament is event production - venues, schedules, ticketing, hospitality. Remove the sport and the work survives unchanged, which is the substitution test answering plainly.

Promised to Sector 18 by Sector 4 and left there. Yoga in India is practised for wellbeing far more than for athletic performance, and it has its own statutory certification scheme, which fitness training does not.

boundary_decisions_needing_your_signoff: SPORTS COACH IS THE SECTOR'S CONTESTED PLACEMENT. DECISIONS.md 2 sends teaching-anything to Sector 12, and a coach teaches. It is kept here because the object of concern is competitive performance - a coach selects, manages load and injury, and is answerable for results. Physical Education Teacher is routed to Sector 12 as the deliberate counterpart. If you reject the split, both belong in 12 and this sector loses its second-largest profession.

ESPORTS PROFESSIONAL is included and it is the weakest profession in this sector on the demand-side test - a few hundred paid roster places nationally. It is kept because it is among the most commonly stated career aspirations of Indian teenagers, which is exactly the population this taxonomy serves, and because saying nothing would leave the aspiration uncorrected. Flagged high.

ADVENTURE SPORTS & OUTDOOR INSTRUCTOR is placed here rather than in Sector 16 with travel. Adventure tourism is the employer and DECISIONS.md 2.2 makes an employer a tag. Confirm when Sector 16 is built, because the same logic could be run the other way for a trekking guide whose day is largely hospitality.

THE SPORTS QUOTA IS A GATE THIS REGISTRY CANNOT YET MODEL. It is the decisive door for most Indian athletes, but its currency is a sporting placing rather than a rank in a test, vacancies are notified per zone with no national total, and the qualifying window is three financial years. Deferred to pending_gates with that reasoning rather than forced into a shape that would misdescribe it.

1.0: TIER C THROUGHOUT despite fresh statute. The National Sports Governance Act 2025 was fetched and read specifically to check whether it credentialed practitioners. It does not - it regulates sports BODIES. That finding is recorded as a verified fact because the opposite assumption would have produced a false Tier A across the sector.

THE SPORTS QUOTA FACT is the most consequential thing in this sector. A 2025 Railway Recruitment Cell notification - 49 posts across 21 sports at 7th CPC Levels 1 to 5 - documents the route by which most Indian athletes actually earn a living: a permanent, pensionable government job obtained because of sport rather than an income from sport. It also documents the risk, since eligibility counts achievements from only the current and previous two financial years.

SPORTS COACH KEPT HERE AND PHYSICAL EDUCATION TEACHER ROUTED TO SECTOR 12. The split is by what the person is answerable for - competitive results versus a curriculum - not by subject. Flagged for sign-off because DECISIONS.md 2 states the teaching rule without this exception.

FIVE OF EIGHT PROFESSIONS carry a required admin_review, all for money. Three distinct shapes: power-law income (Professional Athlete, Esports Professional), per-event fees with no sourced rate (Sports Official & Referee), and a base layer whose independent route has no ceiling (Sports Facility & Turf Professional).

ESPORTS PROFESSIONAL has the widest aspiration-to-reality gap in the dataset: a very large Indian gaming audience against a few hundred paid competitive places, plus a playing career that commonly ends in the mid-twenties. Listed at demand_signal 'low' with that stated plainly rather than omitted.
1.1: MOTORSPORT RACER and RALLY CO-DRIVER added as job roles under Professional Athlete. Motorsport is competitive performance - the object of concern is winning, not moving goods - so it belongs here and not with any form of commercial driving.

THE REASON IT IS WORTH LISTING IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE USUAL ONE. Indian motorsport is PAY-TO-RACE: the driver buys the seat, a season costs many lakh, and sponsorship is raised by the driver rather than paid to them. That inverts the income structure of every other role in this record, whose cost_of_entry is 3.0 lakh. Stated in a nuance as a shape rather than a number because no sourced Indian season cost was found, and added to the admin_review.
economics.distribution applied as part of the approved schema change: Professional Athlete is POWER_LAW, and motorsport is the sharpest case of it in the record.

sector_admin_review.reason: All eight economics blocks are 'judgment'. The most fixable gap is also the most important: the sports quota route is the realistic financial outcome for most Indian athletes and the 7th CPC pay matrix that governs it is a published statutory schedule that simply has not been fetched. Doing so would convert Professional Athlete from a speculative range into the best-evidenced record in Sectors 8 to 11. Beyond that: no sourced match fees for officials, no coaching or academy rates, no Indian esports salary or prize data, and no ground staff wages. Two records - Professional Athlete and Esports Professional - join the growing set (Entrepreneur, Digital Content Creator, Actor) whose income is a power law that a range misrepresents; that is now five records across four sectors and is a schema decision.
